content:
The Art of AI Monks is out.

A 59-page field guide to the avatars, scripts and storefronts behind the robes.

The full manuscript is free. The $9.99 PDF + EPUB supports the research.

Respect to @shalevhvs / Yang Mun.

https://aniccaai.com/the-art-of-ai-monks?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=art_of_ai_monks_book_launch_en
verification: Published book page and source manifest; no retweet or revenue promise
reference_scope: The creator's public storefront is a product-funnel reference; it does not prove X book-launch performance.
evidence_gap: No verified same-target X book-launch performance example was found in the collected research. This is one small first-party launch test.
mechanism: Concrete curiosity about avatars and storefronts; explicit free manuscript; optional paid formats; one destination and creator attribution

measurement.sku_order_scope: Official paginated Stripe Checkout Sessions since SKU creation; includes no paid orders and one expired unpaid canary
